live.rationale: Eight measurements cap the worst-case 95% Wilson half-width below 30 percentage points; the short three-hour window is intentionally labelled limited more often.

24h.rationale: Twenty measurements approximate a 20-point worst-case Wilson half-width and sit below the observed all-region daily first quartile of 24.

7d.rationale: One hundred measurements cap the worst-case 95% Wilson half-width below 10 points and match the observed rolling-seven-day 10th percentile of 102.

historical.rationale: Four hundred measurements cap the worst-case 95% Wilson half-width below 5 points; every rail-served region in the committed year exceeds 4,100.

freshness.owner: Finland Rail data product owner (portfolio simulation)

live.rationale: The page refreshes each minute and the public cache serves live data for at most one minute plus two minutes stale-while-revalidate.

24h.rationale: The governed response is cached for 15 minutes; 30 minutes permits one missed refresh and two hours marks an operationally material gap.

7d.rationale: Completed departure-date partitions are expected daily; 36 hours allows source finalization and 60 hours represents a missed daily publication cycle.

historical.rationale: A fixed, explicitly dated analytical snapshot is not evaluated as an operational feed.
